exact_statement: For every integer m>=2 take canonical b_m(Y)=(-1)^(sum_j Y_(2j-1)Y_(2j)), c_m=b_m-2*1{w=0,Y=0}, G_m with z terminals b_m,c_m, A=2^-m, d=A^2. On c_m query a=Y1, stop a=1 and query exposed partner b=Y2 on a=0; retain all three c leaves with original G reaches 1/4,1/8,1/8 and the unchanged b_m terminal. Every reference is only the corresponding marginal of the original full spectrum of c_m. For the complete two-child CE drops L0,L1, L0<=1 and L1<1+3d/(1+d). With the single rate3 chosen at the original source, the root-weighted CE debit E_Q(3)<-9d/4. The full weighted terminal KL K_F<9/16, hence actual entropy debit E_H(3)=E_Q(3)+K_F<9/16-9d/4. The original additional reserve I_X=(I(b_m)+I(c_m))/2=m+(2m+1)d/2 pays this bill after unchanged old D, with r3-E_H(3)>m-9/16. Old rate2 invoices are retained by E_Q(2)-E_Q(3)=E_H(2)-E_H(3)=1/4+d, and E_H(2)<13/16-5d/4. Full signed frontier identities S_Q=S3+E_Q(3), S_H=S_Q+K_F, S_H-(D+E_H(3))=r+I_X hold. For fixed real C, E_Q(C)->(3-C)/4, so3 is the sharp threshold for nonpositive CE debit of this exact block. No iteration, nonpositive actual entropy debit at rate3, arbitrary-core payment or full FEI is asserted.
